## Checklist

- [ ] No precise coordinates of unpublished, candidate or undiscovered sites. No address carries coordinates.
- [ ] Every new dataset, photograph, model or published source has its licence recorded in `docs/data-sources.md`, and the licence allows what this change does with it.
- [ ] Nothing personal or private is added: names of private people, email addresses, local folder paths, keys or tokens.
- [ ] A reconstruction shows only what a named source states. Estimates are marked `[EST]`. Conjecture is a labelled hypothesis layer, off by default.
- [ ] A theory or reading names who proposes it, gives its sources, and lists evidence for and against (`docs/philosophy.md`).
- [ ] Files stay under 700 lines and functions under about 40.
- [ ] The docs that describe what changed are updated.
- [ ] `pytest` passes, and in `Anatolia/atlas` so do `npx tsc --noEmit` and the `scripts/check_*.mts` for the files touched.
